title: Multilevel Intervention for Precision Oncology
official: Multilevel Veteran-centric Intervention to Improve Precision Oncology
summary: The investigators are rolling out a 3 level intervention designed to improve the use of Precision Oncology at 8 VA medical centers. The 3 components of the intervention are 1: a short educational video for patients, 2: audit and feedback to providers on their Precision Oncology practice patterns, and 3: a change in the electronic medical record to make it easier to order and review results of Precision Oncology tests.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients in the VA with cancer of the lung or prostate who are seen in the oncology clinic

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cancer that did not originate in the prostate or the lung
